claim: How much of the subject the frame contains. The single most load-bearing compositional choice - it decides whether a shot is about a person or about a place.
look_at: The full ladder reads extreme_wide to extreme_close, each step distinct.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes

panels.clause: extremely wide shot, tiny figure, vast environment, scenery
wide shot, full body, environment dominant
medium wide shot, full body, knees up
extreme close-up, eyes only, macro detail
